spec.policies.reason: The active service policies do not match the corporate baseline.
spec.policies.next_step: Ensure the 'Corporate Block List' and 'Geo Fencing' policies are applied in the correct order.

spec.app_firewall.next_step: Assign a Web Application Firewall policy to this load balancer.

appfw.spec.blocking.reason: WAF is not in blocking mode.
appfw.spec.blocking.next_step: Enable blocking mode on the app firewall policy to actively block malicious requests.

appfw.spec.detection_settings.reason: Threat campaign detection is not enabled.
appfw.spec.detection_settings.next_step: Enable threat campaigns in the app firewall detection settings.

appfw.spec.__ONE_OF__bot_protection.reason: Malicious bot blocking is not configured.
appfw.spec.__ONE_OF__bot_protection.next_step: Enable bot protection with malicious bot action set to Block, or use default bot protection settings.

appfw.spec.enable_ai_enhancements.reason: AI risk mitigation is not enabled.
appfw.spec.enable_ai_enhancements.next_step: Enable AI-powered risk mitigation for enhanced threat detection (enterprise feature).

spec.__ONE_OF__tls.next_step: Enable 'HTTPS Auto-Cert' or configure manual 'HTTPS' with a certificate.

spec.__ONE_OF__hsts.next_step: Enable 'Add HSTS Header' in the TLS configuration.

spec.enable_api_discovery.next_step: Enable API Discovery on this load balancer to comply with baseline.

spec.advertise_on_public_default_vip.reason: The load balancer is not advertising on the public default VIP as per baseline.
spec.advertise_on_public_default_vip.next_step: Enable 'Advertise on Public Default VIP' to comply with baseline.

iprep.categories.reason: IP threat intelligence coverage is insufficient in the applied service policies.
iprep.categories.next_step: Ensure a service policy with at least 10 IP threat categories is applied.

geo.blocked_countries.reason: Required geo-blocking countries are not all present in the applied service policies.
geo.blocked_countries.next_step: Ensure a service policy with a deny list blocks Russia (COUNTRY_RU), Iran (COUNTRY_IR), and North Korea (COUNTRY_KP).

appfw.spec.reason: The app firewall policy configuration does not match the baseline.
appfw.spec.next_step: Review the app firewall policy settings and align with the corporate baseline.
